_readme: WorkflowStacks' own products for the daily social job (scripts/social-daily.mjs). Wednesday features one of these, least recently posted first. Add a product with "added": "YYYY-MM-DD" and it goes out on the next run, whatever the day, if that date is within 14 days. "facts" is all the agents may say about it: copy it from the product's own page, and name that page in "source". "by" defaults to WorkflowStacks. "enabled": false keeps an entry out of the rotation.

products.name: Hot this week
products.facts: The open-source AI skills, MCP servers and agents gaining the most GitHub stars this week, ranked by 7-day star growth rather than total stars. Updated daily, emailed every Monday.

products.name: WorkflowStacks plugin for Claude Code
products.facts: The WorkflowStacks catalog inside Claude Code: search 2,000+ open-source AI skills, load any skill's instructions mid-conversation, and keep a personal skill library — via the WorkflowStacks MCP connector. Install it in Claude Code with: /plugin marketplace add rahulsoni25/workflowstacks-emergent

products.name: MCP server configs for Claude Desktop
products.facts: Add tools to Claude Desktop in under a minute. Verified, copy-paste MCP server configs — filesystem, GitHub, web search, browsers, databases, and more. Free.

products.name: WorkflowStacks CLI
products.facts: Install WorkflowStacks skills into Claude Code from the terminal: npx workflowstacks add <slug>

products.name: We build your AI agent for you
products.facts: Describe the workflow you want automated. We build a working AI agent from proven open-source tools, set it up in YOUR tools, and hand you the keys. Working in 7 days. From $500, one-time.

products.facts: Free assets matched to your template. Curated captions, badges, LUTs, overlays and SFX/music — picked for one specific ad style, not a generic stock library. Link-only, nothing to host.

products.facts: We build a digital twin of you in seven days, then write, produce and publish your videos in English and Arabic — and put paid media behind the ones that work. One 45-minute capture session is all you ever sit through.
